native.value: Yue-Hashimoto 1988: classification based on 30+ features in phonology and lexicon of ~60 Yue dialects; two major groups: Siyi Liang-Yang and Delta
native.quote: There are also other proposals with different classificatory criteria. For instance, on the basis of an examination of more than thirty features in phonology and lexicon of about sixty Yuè dialects, Yue-Hashimoto (1988) divides the Yuè dialects into two major groups: the Sìyì Liǎng-Yáng 四邑兩陽 group and the Delta (Sānjiǎozhōu 三角洲) group.

annotation.scheme_en: Kwok, Tsou and Chin: a third source that states both schemes and relates them approximately
annotation.role_en: Kwok, Tsou and Chin report that Yue-Hashimoto (1988) divides Yue into two major groups, 四邑兩陽 Siyi Liang-Yang and the Delta group. The sentence that follows in the same paragraph — the approximate correspondence with the Atlas units — is not a separate record in the graph and is carried here as a curated annotation with its segment locator.
